prBodyNotes: This moves the Go release the images are compressed with, so **every image digest changes**.
`TestGoldenLayerDigest` fails by design: update its two constants in this PR, and say in the release notes that consumers pinning by digest must re-pull.

If CI fails with ``attribute '"X.Y.Z"' missing``, the locked `go-overlay` input is older than the pin this PR proposes. Merge the lock-file-maintenance PR first — it is scheduled earlier (07:00 vs 09:00 Monday) for exactly this — or run `nix flake update go-overlay` on this branch.

customManagers.description: The Go release pinned in flake.nix and provided by go-overlay. Moving it re-digests every image nix-oci writes (DESIGN.md), so it is proposed as its own PR rather than riding along with a nixpkgs bump.
